punchline: A wheelchair at 65 and a death at 96 make a great story and a poor proof.
thirty_sec: Michael Greger tells how his grandmother Frances, at 65 after several bypass operations, was sent home in a wheelchair with end-stage heart disease. She saw Nathan Pritikin on 60 Minutes, took up a plant-based low-fat diet and walking, and lived 31 more years, dying at 96; it is one family account, not a trial.
question: Which striking story are you treating as an answer when it is still a question?
key_contrast: A story raises the question, only data can answer it.
